Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. This card's [All Turns] effect is triggered when one of your Digimon with [Chessmon] in its name is deleted, therefore it won't trigger if such a Digimon isn't deleted.
Card Q&A.q: If an effect such as  prevents deletion when this suspended Digimon would be deleted, can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to unsuspend this Digimon?

Effect: ＜Blocker＞ (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)
[All Turns] When one of your Digimon with [Chessmon] in its name is deleted, unsuspend this Digimon.
